newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms to 477/478 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms to 477/478 per dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed for the second day running as investors sold dollars to buy high yielding Central Bank TEMs, traders said.
The unit closed Wednesday at 476.75/477.75 per dollar.
"Brokers and foreign investors have been selling some of their dollars to buy TEMs," said one trader.
Yields on benchmark six month TEMs rose 105 basis points to 16.54 percent at the Central Bank's regular Wednesday auction.
